Architecture

Plex ODBC views are copied into BigQuery raw_* tables by one Cloud Run job per pipeline, then each pipeline's bq_view list is created on top of them. The probe decides whether a run needs to extract at all.

Schedules

Prod times live in PlexOps.etl_schedule and are started by the etl-dispatcher function. Change a prod time with SQL, not Terraform. Test jobs keep their own nightly Cloud Scheduler entries.
